primary_definition: per-graph DeepGD relative squared distance-error pair sum divided by n(n-1), using stored-forward coordinates and original graph distances
effect_estimator: For each domain and seed, calculate 100*(reference run-mean - treatment run-mean)/max(abs(reference run-mean), floor) for lower-is-better metrics, reverse numerator for higher-is-better; average seeds within fixed domains, then weight domains equally.

bootstrap.seed_resampling: A common seed-index draw across domains, with replacement, preserves shared seed identity.
bootstrap.graph_resampling: Within each domain and each sampled seed occurrence, resample original graph IDs with replacement and apply the identical draw to every paired model/ablation setting.
bootstrap.unit: original graph identity within domain and seed; repeated seed observations are clustered, not independent graphs

factorial: all three main effects and all two/three-factor interactions

multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the seven secondary metrics for each prespecified model comparison in formal Test; all secondary endpoints reported, regardless of significance.
sensitivity: domain-equal estimates by domain and seed
median and standard deviation of domain-seed contrasts
forbidden: mixing Strict Original and Q1 archives
treating Validation intervals as independent Test inference
